props.facing: None; the plant has no intrinsic front.
props.condition: A young living kidney-bean seedling, all one connected organism. The primary root reaches z -0.029 and bears several short lateral roots visible against the exposed perlite face. An upright hypocotyl raises two thick pale-green cotyledons to approximately z 0.025. Attached, split remnants of the loosened red seed coat remain against the cotyledon bases. A slender upright stem continues above them. Two green unifoliate leaves are fully unfolded to opposite sides, spanning approximately x -0.022 to x 0.022 at z 0.044 to 0.050. The small terminal growing tip is plainly visible between and slightly above the leaves at z 0.055. Leaf surfaces receive soft illumination from directly overhead.
